description: Finding a meeting time and creating a draft meeting from a slot.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh and Cuong are active users with Effective shares to An covering 2026-11-24.
Binh and Cuong are both free on 2026-11-24 from 08:30 to 10:30.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: title "Họp triển khai quý IV", planned 2026-11-24T09:00:00+07:00 to 2026-11-24T10:00:00+07:00, InPerson, "Phòng 301", Normal, userIds [Binh, Cuong], includeMe false, buffer 30, accepted [].
cases.return: Meeting Success: Draft meeting saved with roster Binh Chair, Cuong Member, An Secretary and its creation history; the endpoint answers 201 MSG29 ("Tạo cuộc họp thành công.") with Location /api/meetings/{id}.
cases.log: Draft meeting, its status history row and staged invitations saved; no duplicate-time check is made.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh and Cuong are active users with Effective shares to An covering 2026-11-24.
Cuong is busy on 2026-11-24 from 09:00 to 10:00 and is named in acceptedBusyUserIds.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with userIds [Binh, Cuong], buffer 30, accepted [Cuong].
cases.return: Meeting Success: Draft meeting saved with roster Binh Chair, Cuong Member, An Secretary; the endpoint answers 201 MSG29.
cases.log: Draft meeting, its status history row and staged invitations saved.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active user without the Meeting Organizer right.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with userIds [Binh, Cuong].
cases.return: Failure NotOrganizer; the endpoint answers 403 MSG448 ("Bạn cần quyền tạo cuộc họp để thực hiện thao tác này."); nothing is read or created.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with userIds [Binh, Binh] (a duplicate).
cases.return: Failure InvalidInvitees; errors.userIds is "Chọn từ 1 đến 10 người, không trùng và không chọn chính mình."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG277 ("Danh sách thành phần tham dự không hợp lệ.").

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with plannedStartTime "2026-11-24 09:00" (no offset).
cases.return: Failure InvalidSlot; errors.plannedStartTime is "Thời gian không hợp lệ."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG31 ("Thông tin cuộc họp không hợp lệ.").

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with planned 2026-11-10T09:00:00+07:00 to 2026-11-10T10:00:00+07:00 (in the past).
cases.return: Failure InvalidSlot; errors.plannedStartTime is "Thời gian bắt đầu phải sau thời điểm hiện tại."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG31.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with planned end 2026-11-24T09:00:00+07:00 (equal to the start).
cases.return: Failure InvalidSlot; errors.plannedEndTime is "Thời gian kết thúc phải sau thời gian bắt đầu, dài tối đa 8 giờ."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG31.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Dung is an active user outside this slot.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with acceptedBusyUserIds [Dung].
cases.return: Failure InvalidSlot; errors.acceptedBusyUserIds is "Danh sách người bận chỉ gồm người trong khung đã chọn."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG31.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with bufferMinutes 245.
cases.return: Failure InvalidSlot; errors.bufferMinutes is "Cách cuộc họp khác từ 0 đến 4 giờ, bội số của 5 phút."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG31.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh and Cuong are active users with Effective shares to An covering 2026-11-24.
Cuong, free when the slot was found, is now busy on 2026-11-24 from 09:00 to 10:00 and is not accepted.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with userIds [Binh, Cuong], buffer 30, accepted [].
cases.return: Failure SlotTaken; the endpoint answers 409 MSG446 ("Khung giờ này không còn trống. Hãy chọn khung khác."); no meeting is created.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh and Cuong are active users.
Cuong is free at the slot but Binh's share ended 2026-11-20, so 2026-11-24 is unknown for Binh and not accepted.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with userIds [Binh, Cuong], buffer 30, accepted [].
cases.return: Failure SlotTaken; the endpoint answers 409 MSG446 with the same message whether a hidden meeting or an ended share blocks the slot; no meeting is created.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh is active and free at the slot.
Cuong was deactivated after the slot was found.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with userIds [Binh, Cuong], buffer 30, accepted [Cuong].
cases.return: Meeting InvalidParticipants; errors are keyed userIds[1] ("Người dùng không tồn tại hoặc đã ngừng hoạt động."), never participants[1]; the endpoint answers 400 MSG277; no meeting is saved.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; Binh and Cuong are active, shared and free at the slot.
The database fails while saving the meeting.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with userIds [Binh, Cuong], buffer 30, accepted [].
cases.return: Meeting SaveFailed; the endpoint answers 500 MSG35 ("Không thể tạo cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại."); no meeting is kept.
cases.log: Error logged with the actor id.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
The database fails while rechecking the slot.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with userIds [Binh, Cuong], buffer 30, accepted [].
cases.return: Failure ReadFailed; the endpoint answers 500 MSG453 ("Không tải được dữ liệu chia sẻ lịch. Vui lòng thử lại."); no meeting is created.
cases.log: Error logged with the actor id.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer; 10 active users share Effective calendars with An and are free on 2026-11-24 from 07:00 to 17:00.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with 10 userIds, planned 2026-11-24T08:00:00+07:00 to 2026-11-24T16:00:00+07:00 (exactly 8 hours), bufferMinutes 240.
cases.return: Slot checks pass with the longest meeting and the largest buffer; the recheck runs against the shared calendars.

preconditions: Today is 2026-11-18 in Vietnam; now is exactly 2026-11-18 10:00.
An is an active Meeting Organizer.
cases.inputs: actor: An; input: the UTC015 meeting with planned start 2026-11-18T10:00:00+07:00 (exactly now).
cases.return: Failure InvalidSlot; errors.plannedStartTime is "Thời gian bắt đầu phải sau thời điểm hiện tại."; the endpoint answers 400 MSG31.
